name: Returns & exchanges
body: Hi {{ticket.customer.firstname}}, you can return or exchange unused items within 30 days of delivery. Start at fernhillgoods.com/returns and we'll email you a free return label.

name: Black Friday code
body: Use code BF20 at checkout for 20% off everything during our Black Friday sale!

name: Discount code help
body: Only one code works per order. If WELCOME10 isn't working, try SUMMER15 instead.

name: Free shipping
body: Free shipping on all orders over $50 in the US!

name: Holiday hours
body: Our team is away from Dec 24, 2025 to Jan 1, 2026. We'll reply within 1 business day when we're back.

name: Cancel order
body: We can cancel or change your order within 1 hour of purchase. After that it's with our warehouse team.

name: Damaged item
body: So sorry! Please send us a photo within 14 days of delivery and we'll send a free replacement.

name: Gift message
body: You can add a gift message in the cart, and we leave prices off the packing slip.
